risk_note: Admin console home config page (apps/admin; no money logic; codex-run classed it RV2, so the Codex review ran on the money track). Page list and detail, JSON editing of the whole sections array (local check: JSON array only), save draft with dotted-path 20001 fields listed, publish with gray 1..99 or full 100 (no other publish while a gray version exists), gray adjust / full release / stop (rollback of the gray version), rollback of the current versions; every write carries the selected page's latest revision, 20902 rereads without resending and keeps the editor text. Preview token shown as page_key / token / expiry only, no QR code (the app deep-link scheme is not decided). Not built: schema form, drag ordering, add block, approximate preview, validate button. Task id was first mistakenly F1-09i (restored in #784). Rule tests by Codex in one call, Claude spec-test review 1 round pass (7 S2), red on the test machine. Implementation by Opus 5.5 in one round; test machine verify-fast/2 and browser/1 green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass, one S2 (a late version-detail response can show under another page after switching pages) tracked in followups

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagent: pass with seven S2 strength items; three (writes use the selected page and its newest revision, a second write uses the new revision, ratio 1 and 99 accepted) carried into the implementation brief
